activity_summary: You sat through morning prayer at St Helen's. The pew in the north aisle was empty. Master Thwaite added a prayer for the dearth and for a quiet town. Mistress Ansell told you dinner was pease. You did not mark the almanac, and you did not name anyone who was not there.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat the lesson and did not mark a cross.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Prayed for the dearth and for a quiet town.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the conversation out of the lesson, and named dinner.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: For the dearth, and for a quiet town.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A quiet town is enough to ask.
